text:
maria: async standup — what I did: landed kernel alignment patch (removed extra memcpy in attention path), ran microbatch perf on A100, and started a KV stress reproducer. blocker: intermittent kv-evict crash when prefetch and eviction race.

jake: nice. can you paste the perf numbers real quick?

maria: A100, seq128, batch32: before 2.1k tok/s, after patch 2.5k tok/s (~+19%). p50 latency ~12ms, p95 unchanged. will push the bench script to the PR.

srini: seen the kv-evict race before — usually when eviction threshold + concurrent prefetch overlap. do you have a repro?

maria: repro steps: start 8 workers, fill kv ~40k keys, run mixed read/write workload in parallel; about 1 in 20 runs hits the abort. quick repro command:
```bash
python tools/kv_stress.py --workers 8 --keys 40000 --op mix --seed 42
```

jake: i'll pick up the repro and run it on a T4 cluster. pinging @chen for kernel review too.

chen: on it; will review the kernel alignment PR after standup. quick question — does the memcpy removal change any of the kv key offsets or layout?

maria: no, it's purely in the attention buffer copy path, nothing touches KV layout.

runtime-ci: perf-runner finished (1852345690): unit tests + microbench smoke passed. bench delta summary: attention memcpy removed -> 19% throughput up on seq128; no regression on seq512.

alex: FYI — planning a small canary rollout of the new kernel tomorrow 09:00 PT. need owners for rollback and canary monitors.

srini: i'll own rollback and the canary monitors. proposed policy: if p95 latency > baseline + 6% for 5m, auto-fallback to previous kernel.

maria: blocker for rollout: need to tweak eviction threshold to avoid the kv abort under heavy prefetch. jake, can you review the eviction PR at https://github.com/redwood/kv/pull/456?

jake: reviewing now, leaving a couple comments. overall LGTM, will approve after CI clears. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks. today: wire up canary config, land eviction tweak once jake approves, and validate perf on T4.

chen: left one nit in the kernel PR about a null check; otherwise looks clean.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for 2025-06-12T16:00:00Z (owner: maria).

maria: noted — i'll run a manual smoke run 30m before the canary and post results here.

alex: thanks team. small reminder: if anyone needs extra GPU quota for T4 runs, ping infra-reqs.

maria: will do. end of standup.
